name: l0_ambient_pitch
about: CAmbientGeneric::InputPitch 0x101ac690, the datamap INPUT record Pitch (FIELD_FLOAT; walks/L0-r006.md). P0: the variant's float (AcceptInput has converted the parameter to the record's type; a non-numeric parameter is 0.0). P1: > 255.0f -> 255, else < 0.0f -> 0, then __ftol (truncation). P2: +0x494 (m_dpv[0x3c]) <- pitch, written whether or not a source is live and with no m_fActive gate. P3: the CACHED source handle +0x4c8 only (never re-resolved here): valid -> FUN_101cdac0 (edict, source GetAbsOrigin, name, +0x4a4 * 0.01, +0x454, m_nSndFlags | 0x2, pitch) -- so a stopped (start-silent) ambient still emits its pitch change, as retail does. Pitch 125 -> 125; 300 -> 255; 'abc' -> 0; -5 -> 0.

expect.label: started
expect.match: fn=CAmbientGeneric::vfunc113 va=0x101ac9c0 phase=emit flags=0x8 vol=1.00 level=70 pitch=100

expect.label: e125
expect.match: fn=CAmbientGeneric::InputPitch va=0x101ac690 phase=emit flags=0x2 vol=1.00 level=70 pitch=125 origin=.* source=self

expect.label: e255
expect.match: fn=CAmbientGeneric::InputPitch va=0x101ac690 phase=emit flags=0x2 vol=1.00 level=70 pitch=255

expect.label: e0_text
expect.match: fn=CAmbientGeneric::InputPitch va=0x101ac690 phase=emit flags=0x2 vol=1.00 level=70 pitch=0

expect.label: stopped_emit
expect.match: fn=CAmbientGeneric::InputPitch va=0x101ac690 phase=emit flags=0x2 vol=0.80 level=70 pitch=90

notes: On the arena host instead of sp_tutorial_1's CityAmbience (the walk's suggestion): the same input on the same class, with the handle self-bound by the activation pass, and no map boot. amb_stopped's volume word is health 8 -> 80 -> vol=0.80 on the emit.
